## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Restarts the action list from the beginning if every condition in the condition list is true. If any are false, execution continues with the next action. To prevent an infinite loop, a [Wait](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/wait) action must execute between the start of the action list and this action.
````
